role: proposed extension of selected catalogue direction
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Design a complete long-scroll DESKTOP WEB RESUME PAGE for Alejandro Ortiz Corro, extending the selected AOHYS 'living catalogue' visual direction in the input reference. Output one tall 1024x1536 image showing a desktop webpage scaled to fit its full length, flat straight-on screenshot without browser chrome. The reference contributes neutral white ground, generous spacing, brown ink #473C33, restrained high-contrast serif headings, clean sans body, honey #FEC868 actions, olive #ABC270 and apricot #FDA769 accents. Do NOT reuse its Central Belleza illustration or software hero content.
Structure from top to bottom: compact horizontal navigation with exploratory custom lowercase wordmark 'aohys' at left, Work / Practice / Resume / Contact / ES at right. Make wordmark more distinctive than plain typesetting: closely joined a-o forms in a crisp humanist semi-serif, subtle apricot cut in o, remaining hys connected rhythmically, still immediately readable aohys. At top main content: generous serif title 'Alejandro Ortiz Corro', below 'Senior Software Engineer', short sentence 'I build software products from the first conversation to release.' Wide left biography, right honey action 'Download CV' and quiet 'English · Español'. Below a slim row 'Frontend specialization. Full product delivery.'
The middle is a dignified readable work-history layout: narrow date/company rail at left and concrete contributions right, not a cramped PDF viewer. Heading 'Experience'. Row '2023–Present · Tala' / 'Senior Frontend Developer' and short text 'Customer-support workflows, partner access and a React-to-Next.js migration. Work delivered with cross-functional teams.' Row '2015–Present · AOHYS' / 'Founder' / 'Independent products across booking, nutrition and business operations. Product decisions, frontend, backend and release.' Under AOHYS small text links 'Central Belleza · NutriPlan · ETERIA'. Row '2022–2023 · Drift' / 'Senior Frontend Developer' / 'A video-recording Chrome extension, browser APIs and manifest requirements.' A compact 'Earlier work' line lists 'Prenuvo · AutoZone · Accenture · NEORIS/CEMEX' without invented facts.
Lower portion: heading 'Technical experience', two uncluttered text columns with 'Frontend' and 'Backend & delivery' (React, TypeScript, Next.js / Convex, Node.js, Stripe, Cloudflare, CI/CD). Education simple readable lines 'Software Development · UnADM' and 'Maritime Trade · IT Boca del Río'. Footer tasteful olive-tinted strip: 'Have something in mind?' and 'Let’s talk'. Small footer 'Alejandro Ortiz Corro / AOHYS'. This is CV WEB design, no headshot, no infographics or percentage bars, no invented metrics, awards, clients or testimonials. All essential copy readable. Typography controlled, no huge hero overwhelming professional history. Craft as high as reference but suitable for sustained reading.
